status: Fixed before this audit was run; not externally preregistered.
model: Homogeneous massless classical Kantowski-Sachs constant-rate RTA; c=8*pi*G=1
closure_rule: Project the same transport operator onto retained even Legendre modes; set all higher coefficients to zero. No fitted parameters.
error_scope: Maximum over the SAME sampled interval [0,0.30], including initial transients. Reference denominator throughout. Not an AI forecast error or a state-pair separation.
admissibility: Report finite-moment positive-measure feasibility and the minimum of the literal truncated polynomial separately. Conservative acceptance requires both.
independence: Heldout geometries do not enter any coefficient fitting or threshold tuning; there is no learning. Not a statistically representative population.
limitations: Only three zero-tail closures, not the minimum over all closure laws
No quantum effects, two-particle correlations, spin, evaporation, exterior matching, or singularity endpoint
Finite grids and method comparisons are not rigorous global error bounds
No automatic validity-warning classifier is trained in this stage
